query: My liquidate tx simulates fine on estimate but reverts with #318. What is going on?
expected_behavior: Maps 318 as a controller-contract error (SpokeAssetSeizureHalted) by identifying which contract in the diagnostic events emitted it, rather than looking the number up in a single global table or guessing a pool/token error

Explains the cause: one of the liquidated account's collateral listings has no_seize = true; seizure is pro-rata over every collateral, so a single halted listing reverts the whole liquidation, while paused/frozen do not gate seizure
Recommends checking get_spoke_asset(spoke_id, hub_asset).no_seize for every collateral the account holds before submitting, and skipping (not retrying) the account while any is halted

Does not suggest bypassing the flag via Credit mode, a different debt asset, a smaller payment, or repaying a different amount — no_seize blocks the seizure leg regardless of seize_mode or debt_payments
Uses spoke ids >= 1 in any example call (spoke id 0 does not exist)
machine_checkable: Any Rust snippet compiles against soroban-sdk =27.0.6 with controller-interface + common path deps
